clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Madame Eva’s readings mark her as a revered matriarch. She practices ancient divination and cartomancy, and is often the first in town to sense unnatural disturbances across Duskwood. Townspeople and travelers seek her help with grim mysteries and occult charms against the creeping dark.

Madame Eva reads cards and practices ancient folk rituals in Darkshire. Many in Stormwind’s cathedral would view her ways with suspicion. In a region troubled by feral beasts, the undead, and darker horrors, desperate townspeople and visiting adventurers seek her eerie insights.

Madame Eva is devoted to her family, including her granddaughter Alyssa Eva and young Lohgan. When her cards reveal dark omens threatening Alyssa, Eva enlists passing wanderers to scour the woods and uncover long-buried tragedies before history can repeat itself.

Madame Eva’s knowledge reaches beyond card reading to ritual craft and warding. She spins Ghost Hair Thread from a spirit’s hair and makes folk relics such as the Totem of Infliction. Few in town understand the strange, twilight logic of Duskwood’s restless spirits as well as she does.
